item.title: goodbye black
item.description: mood: grown up?? · music: tüntolk (the happy one) i got into the medical college. nurse. mama won. actually i won also, i want it now. so this is the last post here probably. i will keep the blog for memory. if you are 16 and wearing black in talas: it gets better. and tüntolk is NOT just noise.…

item.title: results
item.description: mood: ok · music: tüntolk (the happy one) the results: iradi 84, english 91, biology 79, maths 62. mama said "well, maths is a thing that happens to everyone". the college wants 70 average. i have 79. wait. i have to do the math. (79+84+91+62)/4 = 79. ok. ok. YES. dont tell maths.

item.description: mood: empty · music: none the national test, 3 days. in the hall a man with a clock walked between the desks and every time he coughed my heart stopped. there is no Russian paper this year, they took it away, so for the first time everyone in our hall wrote in Iradi or English. item.title: last bell
item.description: mood: everything · music: none the last bell. we had ribbons and flowers, a girl from the first class rang the bell on a big boy's shoulder. my teacher cried, i didnt cry. then i went behind the gym and cried a little. Zhanyl hugged me and said "I am not good at saying things" and then said it…

item.title: the light is back (mostly)
item.description: mood: soft · music: Kara Suu (track 6) we have light the whole evening now. Juju's kittens (adults now) sit by the lamp like they invented it. i did homework until midnight just because i could. winter is over. i hope. mama says do not say that out loud.

item.title: cold
item.description: mood: frozen · music: none (no electricity lol) we have light only 2 hours in the evening. i do homework with a candle like in 1800. juju sleeps on the radiator but it is cold so she is confused. writing this at the internet club, they have a generator. 20 som for half an hour.

item.title: rain
item.description: mood: perfect · music: the rain it rained all day. i love when the street smells like a stone. we sat in the corridor of the school and nobody went home, the teacher let us stay, and we told stories about Talas ghosts. Zhanyl told one about the Kariz bride, a woman in white who walks the old water…
